hypothesis: BytesView is a non-escaping zero-copy borrow and ordinary Bytes receives exactly one compiler-inserted drop without manual surface cleanup.
competing_explanation_1: Zero-copy evidence is only an optimizer artifact; the pre-optimization MIR or generated C may still allocate or copy.
competing_explanation_2: The workload is memory-bound, so timing can hide extra instructions, allocation, or payload copies.
falsifier: Any hidden view allocation/free/copy, wrong pointer-offset relation, ownership imbalance, sanitizer failure, unexpected corpus result, valid<500, invalid<300, or non-hermetic full suite.
minimal_change: Expand only Bytes evidence families and accounting, add zero-copy/automatic-drop probes, and make the unavailable-provider test independent of external roots.
required_evidence: positive+negative+boundary+falsification; independent reference/surface/MIR/native agreement; ASan+UBSan+LSan; zero-copy and drop proofs; one hermetic full suite; frozen hashes.
stop_condition: Stop with BYTES_SAFETY_DEFECT_FOUND on a safety defect; otherwise stop after one decision run with BYTES_EVIDENCE_CLOSED or BYTES_EVIDENCE_INCOMPLETE.
